scope_statement: Every bitget-signal tool (19) and every bitget-mcp-server catalog entry (67) called 1 time(s), keyless, through the same shared client the desk and the research console use (market/rpc.py). NOT CLAIMED: that 1 round(s) characterise a service — `eval/skillreliability.py` shows the same calls reading differently a day apart. NOT CLAIMED: that a domain error is Bitget's fault; for bitget-mcp-server it can be a symbol spelling the catalog does not document, and every attempted form is published so a reader can judge. An 'empty' is a tool answering with nothing, which is a fact about coverage, never read as a quiet market.
